title: Gate Raiders
story: Attackers carry the ball through a castle gate while defenders protect the kingdom.
setup: 15x20 area, four to six two-cone gates and pairs with one ball.
instructions: A controlled dribble through any gate scores.
coach_lens: Notice speed changes, disguise and use of the body without prescribing one correct move.

challenge: Score at a different gate each time.
low_attendance: Use one smaller area and repeat short rounds.
high_attendance: Duplicate the area so every player stays involved.
limited_equipment: Use shoes or field markings when cones or goals are unavailable.

source.title: How to design football practices
source.reviewer_notes: SmallSide-authored 1v1 game using original language and federation practice-design principles. Version 2 adds standardized delivery metadata and an original SmallSide diagram without changing the activity rules.

questions: How can you make the defender move before you escape?
safety: Check spacing and playing surface before starting.

diagram.alt: Two pairs play one versus one among several cone gates, with arrows through open gates.
